# AgentScript (ASL) — LLM reference

**Generated from `prelude/prelude.json`. Do not edit.**

An S-expression language for LLM agents: balanced delimiters, whitespace-insensitive, a closed vocabulary, and a checker that runs before anything executes. One source transpiles to Python, Rust, TypeScript, Go, WebAssembly and a reference interpreter, and a differential gate fails if any two disagree.

## Forms

<!-- not-agentscript: a grammar summary written with `...` placeholders -->
```lisp
(module path/name :d "One sentence." :x [Sym ...] :i [(path/mod :a alias)])
(dfs Name (:f key I64 "doc") ...)
(dfe Name (:c tag [(arg I64) ...] "doc") ...)
(df name [(arg I64)] -> I64 :d "..." body)
(df ! main [(args (List Str))] -> (Result Unit IoError) body)
(let [(name value) ...] body)
(mt subject ((tag binder ...) result) ...)
(if test then else)
(cond ((test) value) (:else fallback))
(try result-expr)
```

Every short spelling above has a long one: `df` is `defun`, `dfs` is `defschema`, `dfe` is `defenum`, `mt` is `match`, `:d` is `:doc`, `:x` is `:export`, `:i` is `:import`, `:a` is `:as`, `:f` is `:field`, `:c` is `:case`. They are the same form. A short spelling counts only in the position shown — a record field named `x` is still written `(P :x 1)` and means a field, not an export list.

## Types

- Primitive: `Bool`, `I32` (`Int32`), `I64` (`Int64`), `F64` (`Float64`), `Str` (`String`), `Unit`
- Constructed: `(List …)`, `(Option …)`, `(Result …)`, `(Pair …)`, `(Map …)`
- `(Option T)` is `(some v)` / `(none)`; `(Result T E)` is `(ok v)` / `(err e)`.
- `IoError` is a closed union: `(not-found)`, `(permission-denied)`, `(already-exists)`, `(invalid-path)`, `(interrupted)`, `(other)`.
- A `Map` key must be orderable; `Float64` is not a legal key type.
- Reserved width names, accepted and resolved to the type shown, carrying none of that width's semantics: `F32` → `Float64`.

## Vocabulary

All 107 names. Nothing outside this list exists — there is no `sqrt`, no `s/concat`, no `l/map`, no `nth`.

- **Arithmetic**: `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `mod`, `checked-div`, `checked-mod`, `neg`, `abs`, `min`, `max`
- **Comparison and logic**: `=`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `and`, `or`, `not`
- **String**: `string-length`, `string-empty?`, `str`, `string-slice`, `string-index-of`, `string-contains?`, `string-starts-with?`, `string-ends-with?`, `string-split`, `string-join`, `string-upper`, `string-lower`, `string-trim`, `string-reverse`, `string-replace`, `string-chars`, `string-from-int64`, `string-from-float64`, `string-to-int64`, `string-to-float64`
- **Numeric conversion**: `int32-to-int64`, `int64-to-int32`, `int64-to-float64`, `float64-to-int64`
- **List**: `list`, `list-empty?`, `list-length`, `list-get`, `list-head`, `list-tail`, `list-cons`, `list-append`, `list-reverse`, `list-slice`, `list-contains?`, `list-index-of`, `list-sort`, `list-sort-by`, `map`, `filter`, `fold`, `range`, `zip`, `list-sum`, `list-min`, `list-max`
- **Map**: `map-empty`, `map-get`, `map-set`, `map-remove`, `map-has?`, `map-size`, `map-keys`, `map-values`, `map-pairs`, `map-from-pairs`
- **Option, Result, Pair**: `some`, `none`, `ok`, `err`, `is-some?`, `is-none?`, `is-ok?`, `is-err?`, `option-or`, `result-or`, `option-map`, `result-map`, `result-map-err`, `option-to-result`, `result-to-option`, `pair`
- **I/O**: `not-found`, `permission-denied`, `already-exists`, `invalid-path`, `interrupted`, `other`, `read-line`, `read-all`, `print`, `println`, `eprintln`, `file-read`, `file-write`, `file-append`, `file-exists?`

## Rules a generator must not break

1. `if` has three parts; `cond` ends with `:else`; a match covers every case.
2. Bindings are immutable; there is no assignment.
3. No implicit numeric conversion — convert explicitly.
4. Fallible lookups return `(Option T)`; they never throw.
5. A function that touches the world carries `!` on its signature.
6. Nothing is exported unless the module header lists it.
7. Every exported function and every record field carries a doc string.

## Tools

- `asl check <file>` — types and the semantic rules a grammar cannot express.
- `asl fmt <file>` — canonical layout, preserving the file's projection.
- `asl transcode <file> --to nano|verbose` — switch projection, structurally.
- `asl build <file> --target wasm|rs|ts|go|py` — transpile.
- `asl parse <file>` — the self-hosted parser.
- MCP server (`tools/mcp/server.py`): `asex_check`, `asex_eval`, `asex_format`, `asex_compress_module`.

Full specification: https://aslang.dev/llms-full.txt
